task.title: Iterate dict items, not keys
task.notes:
Micro-drill. If they ask whether an approach 'counts', say idiomatic means what a fluent reviewer would write today; no other resolutions to give. Targets: keys-iteration, append-transform-loop.

Idiomatic reference (for your judgment and post-pass debriefs; never hand it over before their run passes):
def flag_overdue(balances, limit):
    return [name for name, balance in balances.items() if balance > limit]
task.appendix:
Targets: keys-iteration, append-transform-loop

Hidden checks (behavior must be preserved):
assert flag_overdue({"ana": 120, "bo": 30, "cy": 75}, 50) == ["ana", "cy"]
assert flag_overdue({"ana": 10}, 50) == []
assert flag_overdue({}, 0) == []
assert flag_overdue({"a": 1, "b": 2}, 1) == ["b"]
assert flag_overdue({"x": 5, "y": 5}, 5) == []
